files.title: T.Y.B.A. Travel and Tourism Management Syllabus From 2026-27
files.programme: B. A. Travel And Tourism Management

units.title: Introduction to Cultural and Heritage Tourism
units.topics: Meaning and Concept of Culture and Heritage, Types of Culture: Material and Non-material, Meaning and Scope of Cultural Tourism , Meaning and Scope of Heritage Tourism, Relationship between Culture, Heritage, and Tourism, Importance of Cultural and Heritage Tourism in India.

units.title: Cultural and Heritage Resources of India
units.topics: Tangible Heritage: Monuments, Forts, Temples, Museums, Intangible Heritage: Traditions, Festivals, Art, Music, Dance , UNESCO World Heritage Sites in India (Overview) , Major Cultural Tourism Circuits in India, Role of local communities in cultural tourism.

units.title: Heritage Conservation and Management
units.topics: Concept of Heritage Conservation , Need for Preservation of Cultural Heritage , Role of Government and Organizations (ASI, UNESCO) , Heritage Laws and Policies in India (Basic overview), Heritage Management Practices , Challenges in Heritage Conservation.

units.title: Tourism Development and Impacts on Heritage
units.topics: Role of Tourism in Cultural Promotion , Positive and Negative Impacts of Tourism on Heritage , Sustainable Cultural Tourism Development , Case Studies of Heritage Tourism in India (e.g., Ajanta –Ellora, Jaipur, Varanasi), Responsible Tourism Practices.

files.title: S.Y.B.A. Travel and Tourism Management (NEP) Syllabus AC Year 2025-26
files.programme: B. A. Travel And Tourism Management

units.title: Indian Tourism Geography
units.topics: Overview of Indian tourism regions : (North, South, East, West, Central, Northeast) , Tourism circuits and themes (Spiritual, Heritage, Adventure, Eco -tourism, etc.), Importance of domestic tourism in India.

units.title: North India
units.topics: Key States: Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Uttarakhand. Major Attractions: Delhi – Red Fort, Qutub Minar, India Gate. Uttar Pradesh – Taj Mahal, Varanasi Ghats, Sarnath. Rajasthan – Jaipur, Udaipur, Jaisalmer. Himachal Pradesh – Shimla, Manali. Uttarakhand: Rishikesh, Nainital. J&K – Srinagar, Gulmarg, Vaishno Devi.

units.title: South India
units.topics: Key States: Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana. Major Attractions: Tamil Nadu – Madurai, Chennai, Mahabalipuram. Kerala – Munnar, Alleppey, Kochi, Ayurveda tourism. Karnataka – Hampi, Mysore, Coorg. Telangana – Hyderabad, Warangal. Andhra Pradesh – Tirupati, Visakhapatnam.

units.title: Western & Central India
units.topics: Key States: Maharashtra, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Goa Major Attractions: Maharashtra – Ajanta & Ellora, Shirdi. Gujarat – Gir National Park, Somnath, Rann of Kutch. Madhya Pradesh – Khajuraho, Kanha & Bandhavgarh National Parks. Goa – Beaches & Fort Aguada.

units.title: Eastern & Northeastern India
units.topics: Key States: West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Assam, Meghalaya, Sikkim, Arunachal Pradesh Major Attractions: West Bengal – Kolkata, Sundarbans, Darjeeling. Odisha – Puri, Konark, Bhubaneswar. Bihar – Bodh Gaya, Nalanda Northeast – Kaziranga National Park, Shillong, Tawang, Gangtok

units.title: Travel Photography
units.topics: Definition and evolution of travel photography , Importance of photography in travel documentation and promotion, Types of travel photography: landscape, portrait, cultural, wildlife, architectural

units.title: Basics of Photography
units.topics: Camera types: DSLR, mirrorless, smartphone cameras Understanding settings: ISO, shutter speed, aperture Composition techniques: rule of thirds, framing, lighting Ethical photography practices.

units.title: Travel Writing
units.topics: Definition and forms: blog, article, travelogue, journal, social media captions , Essential elements: setting, narrative voice, sensory detai l, Differences between travel writing and guidebook writing , Language style and tone for different audiences.

units.title: Integrating Photography and Writing
units.topics: Creating photo essays and multimedia blogs, Captioning and describing travel images , Visual storytelling using text and images , Publishing on blogs, magazines, and social media platforms.

units.title: Field Visit & Report Writing
units.topics: Field Visit/photo walk, Writing a travel report based on the trip, Creating a photo story or travel blog entry.

units.title: Geography and Tourism
units.topics: Definition and scope of geography in tourism , Importance of geographical knowledge in travel and tourism planning, Types of geography: physical, cultural and economic.

units.title: Physical Geography and Tourism
units.topics: Landforms and tourism: mountains, deserts, coasts, islands, Climate and tourism: tropical, temperate, polar zones, Natural resources: rivers, forests, beaches, national parks , Natural hazards and their effects on tourism.

units.title: Human and Cultural Geography
units.topics: Population and settlement patterns , Language, religion, and traditions as tourist attractions , World heritage sites and cultural landscapes , Role of festivals and cultural events in tourism.

units.title: Major Tourist Regions of the World
units.topics: Tourism in North America, Europe, Asia, and Oceania. Key attractions: landmarks, cities, and natural wonders Tourism flows and travel routes . Regional tourism themes (e.g., adventure, heritage, beach) , Role of geography in developing tourism circuits

units.title: Tools of Tourism Geography
units.topics: Use of maps, globes, and atlases in tourism , Geographic Information Systems (GIS) in tourism planning , Time zones, International Date Line, latitude and longitude , Map reading and route planning.

units.title: Introduction
units.topics: Importance of practical exposure in Travel & Tourism, Objectives and planning of study tours and internships, Guidelines for report writing and documentation.

units.title: Field Training / Internship
units.topics: Placement in Travel Agencies, Tour Operators, Hotels, Airlines, or Tourism Boards , Tasks may include ticketing, itinerary planning, customer service, back - office support, Students must maintain a daily logbook or internship diary.

units.title: Study Tour
units.topics: Conduct a regional/national tour with faculty coordination, Visit tourist destinations, heritage sites, hotels, airports, transport hubs, etc. , Interaction with tourism professionals at the site.

units.title: Report Preparation and Presentation
units.topics: Writing of two reports: On -the-Job Training Report & Study Tour Report , Report structure: Introduction, Objective, Activities, Observations, Learnings, Phot os, Power Point/Oral presentation by each student.
